name: Continuity Token
description_short: Cold-storage backups of Cardano NFT media.
description_long: Token-gated backup service for Cardano NFT media, which typically lives off-chain on IPFS and survives only as long as someone keeps pinning it. Holding Continuity Tokens in a wallet automatically enrolls its assets: each token covers 2 GB and unlocks a tier — Hot (multi-server global pinning, refreshed every epoch, 10+ years), Cold (archival M-DISC media stored in an EN 1143-1 grade-10 underground safe, 100+ years), and Arctic (data written to piqlFilm and deposited in the Arctic World Archive in Svalbard, 1,000+ years). Backed by a distributed group of 'Continuity Angels' holding access to cold storage as a failsafe. Used by SpaceBudz and Cardano Pages.
